source: Naruto ch.1 (mangapill), páginas 5/9/10 — texto real tipografado
note: Ground truth escrito a mao a partir da leitura visual de cada recorte em crops/. p5-* sao caixas de narracao sobre arte pintada/texturizada (sem balao) — caso-alvo do item de inpainting.

items.p9-hokage-yes: YES? WHAT IS IT? SOME NEW OUTRAGE BY NARUTO, I PRESUME?
items.p9-graffiti: THAT YOUNG DEVIL IS GRAFFITI-ING THE MOUNTAINSIDE IMAGES OF ALL THE HEROES OF OUR VILLAGE-YOUR HONORED FOREBEARS!
items.p9-sickofit: WE'RE SICK OF IT! GROW THE HECK UP!
items.p10-cantapolog: LORD HOKAGE... I CAN'T APOLOGIZE ENOUGH... EH?
items.p10-howdareyou: HOW DARE YOU?! WHO DO YOU THINK YOU ARE?!
items.p5-oncetime: ONCE UPON A TIME, THERE LIVED A FOX SPIRIT WITH NINE TAILS. AND HE WAS SO POWERFUL THAT WHENEVER HE SHOOK THOSE TAILS, LANDSLIDES AND TSUNAMIS WOULD RESULT.
items.p5-suffering: THE SUFFERING PEOPLE GATHERED THE GREAT SHINOBI CLANS TO FIGHT THIS MENACE. FINALLY, RISKING HIS LIFE, ONE NINJA WAS ABLE TO IMPRISON ITS SOUL..
items.p5-shinobidied: HAVING DEFEATED THE DEMON, THE BRAVE SHINOBI DIED.
items.p5-fourthhokage: THAT SHINOBI WAS THE FOURTH HOKAGE, THE FIRE SHADOW, CHAMPION OF THE VILLAGE HIDDEN IN THE LEAVES...
